body.summary: In gate.ts: CompletionHook and registerCompletionHook; consultHook is called after the tracker is loaded and before the holder is read for author, build, open-signoff, revise and release (a returned outcome is the answer, 'continue' lets the gate decide, none registered continues, a throw of any value refuses with 'the completion hook failed: ...'); a module-level insideHook flag makes a gate call made by the hook itself (its release) skip the hook, and it is reset in a finally. A stage with no recorded issue now tries ensureUnitIssue (seam: ensureIssue) with the loaded port: if it creates or finds one the gate then decides on the live assignee; if not it returns no-issue with creationFailure, and allowFirstAuthor is true only for action author when the unit's own artifact (Define, LLD or plan) does not exist yet (seam: artifactExists), false for every other action. Three new tests in gate.test.ts carry the named tests; the earlier t2 test's missing-issue assertion now expects no-issue.
